sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and time limit
sections.what: Brings in the AI helpers, the resume cleaning helper, and the prompt library, and allows 5 minutes for the request.
sections.why: Reasoning models can take a long time to answer.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Choose the writing task
sections.what: Reads the request, handles skill gap separately, and picks the prompt, creativity level, and length for the chosen action.
sections.why: Each document type needs its own length and style.
sections.watch_out: Adding a new action means updating several places, or it will return Unknown action.

sections.name: POST (part 2)
sections.title: Call the AI and clean output
sections.what: Sets the length for refinements, calls the AI, cleans resume text for applicant tracking systems, and returns the text.
sections.why: Resume text must be plain so tracking software can read it.
sections.watch_out: Only resumes and resume refinements are cleaned, so other documents keep their formatting.

summary: The main writing endpoint. Produces resumes, cover letters, outreach messages, and other documents, or refines an existing one, based on the requested action.
purpose: Creates and edits written job search documents.
why: Likely reason: one route handles many writing tasks, each with its own prompt and length.
how: Reads the action and inputs, picks the prompt and settings for that action, calls the AI, cleans resume text for applicant tracking systems, and returns the content. The skill-gap action returns structured data instead.
inputs: Action name, profile, application details, optional target contact, provider settings, current content, instruction, and research context.
outputs: Generated content or structured data, or an error with status 400 or 500.
risks: An unknown action returns 400. The refine step uses a request header to pick the document type, so a wrong header gives the wrong length limit.
debug: Check the action name matches the list in the code. If documents are cut off, check the token limit for that action.
